theme: Graphite GPU backend and perf hardening
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings and a Vulkan-via-Silk.NET package, plus several native leak fixes.
highlights_body: Alongside the new GPU surface, this release fixes several native use-after-free and memory leaks, adds containerized Linux/Alpine/Nano Server test legs, and converts all solutions to the new .slnx format.

bullets.lead: Skia bumped to Chrome milestone m152
bullets.detail: Updates the bundled Skia engine to m152, folding in upstream stability fixes merged during the preview cycle.
Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux.
Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface for asynchronous, backend-neutral pixel reads.
Fixes a use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator, a use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With*, and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create's raster failure path.

bullets.lead: Performance improvements across the hot path
bullets.detail: Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration check, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, and cuts a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo.

bullets.lead: Broader test and Windows build coverage
bullets.detail: Adds containerized Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server test legs, initializes the MSVC environment once per native build, stops pinning a default Windows SDK version, and uses FreeType for Nano Server font support.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Wired up FreeType for Nano Server font support
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Fixed the native Windows build to initialize the MSVC environment once per build
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

harfbuzz_summary: No HarfBuzz API changes; the binding picks up the .slnx solution-format conversion and the new containerized test legs alongside the rest of the repo.
